title: Rank-zero bundle section comparison equals normalized etale section coordinates
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, S a Noetherian scheme and M an O_S-module locally free of rank zero. Suppose the bundle projection π is etale, and let e:E≅S have inverse the bundle zero section. For every graph/homotopy-normalized comparison family C, the specified bundleSectionRankZeroComparison A S M e hz equals (finiteSmoothSectionCoordinates A C π z).hom. These constructions are those of [def-trf-bundle-section-orientation-data, def-pur-finite-smooth-comparison-coordinates]. This comparison involves no integration trace, no Rees family and no annihilating integer.

proof.text: The zero section is an isomorphism, so its structural square over the identity is Cartesian. Apply section-coordinate base change. The etale sum right adjoint identity law identifies the normalized omega coordinates on the identity with its adjunction-conjugate identity comparison.

Replace the ordinary constant pullback at the identity by the monoidal unit comparison. Expand the specified bundleSectionRankZeroComparison. Its middle factor is the section base-change map, and its last factors are the identity section coordinates just calculated. Apply the base-change identity, commute the section coordinates through the inverse identity-pullback isomorphism by naturality, and cancel the two identity constraints.

lean.statement:
theorem rankZeroBundleSection_coordinates
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S]
    (M : S.Modules) [M.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank 0]
    [Etale (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S 0 M)]
    (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme S 0 M ≅ S)
    (hz : e.inv = VectorBundleZeroSection.zero S 0 M)
    (C : FiniteSmoothCompactSupportComparisons A)
    (hC : FiniteSmoothComparisonNormalized A C) :
    bundleSectionRankZeroComparison A S M e hz =
      (finiteSmoothSectionCoordinates A C (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S 0 M)
        (VectorBundleZeroSection.zero S 0 M)).hom
